Activate 1 (manipulate)

Magic mushrooms are the treat that Hoddydoddies are most famous for, as they've made their way into various fairy tales across the planes. While these mushrooms are real, their effects can vary, so those who seek them out should be very careful about what strain they consume. Additionally, consuming more than one magic mushroom within a day causes the user to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 3} until their next daily preparations.

A wild magic mushroom glimmers a myriad different colors. After eating it, roll twice on the following table to determine the wild magic mushroom's effects; you gain both effects for 10 minutes. If two 6s are rolled, reroll one die.

d6
